description: Memora RAG evaluation set. Grounded in data/documents content: 9 answerable questions + 1 unanswerable probe.

cases.question: Within how many days can customers on monthly self-service plans request a full refund?
cases.reference: 30 days from the original purchase date.

cases.question: How much does Business Support cost per month and what does it add?
cases.reference: Business Support costs 199 USD per month. It adds live chat, a four hour first-response target and up to five named support contacts.

cases.question: What does Enterprise Support include for critical Priority 1 issues?
cases.reference: 24/7 phone support, a dedicated Technical Account Manager, a one hour first-response target and quarterly architecture reviews. Critical tickets can be raised anytime including weekends and holidays.

cases.question: What is a Priority 2 issue and how fast is the first response on Business Support?
cases.reference: Priority 2 means a major feature is unusable but a workaround exists. First response is eight hours for Business Support.

cases.question: What is the annual learning budget and what approval is needed for big purchases?
cases.reference: Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1500 USD. It does not carry over. Purchases above 500 USD need manager approval in advance.

cases.question: What are the core hours employees must be available for?
cases.reference: Employees work flexible hours but must be available during the core hours of 10:00 to 16:00.

cases.question: When is an expense claim paid out?
cases.reference: Approved expenses are reimbursed with the next monthly payroll run if submitted before the 25th of the month. Claims submitted later roll to the following month.

cases.question: How do refunds for annual self-service subscriptions work?
cases.reference: Annual self-service subscriptions can be refunded pro-rata for the unused whole months remaining, minus a 10 percent administrative fee.

cases.question: Where are TechNova's offices and how many people does it employ?
cases.reference: TechNova employs 240 people across three offices: Austin (Americas), Dublin (Europe) and Singapore (Asia Pacific). It was founded in 2016 in Austin, Texas.

cases.question: What is TechNova's maximum annual cloud infrastructure spend?
cases.reference: The indexed documents do not mention any cloud infrastructure spend, so this cannot be answered from them.
